title: AMD revenue forecast disappoints as crypto demand subsides, shares plummet
text: AMD revenue forecast disappoints as crypto demand subsides, shares plummet Wednesday, 24 October 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) Advanced Micro Devices Inc on Wednesday forecast fourth-quarter revenue below estimates as the chipmaker faces dwindling demand from cryptocurrency miners for its high-margin graphic processors and excess inventory, sending its shares down 22 percent.
